name: Hesla, The Broken Ember
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-20: The Overthrow of Ambition

items.name: Riftcarver
items.description: Derived from a farming tool used to mow down long grains and cereals, this weapon has a long wooden shaft with protruding handles, capped with a curved blade set at a right angle.

items.name: Explorer's Clothing
items.description: Adventurers who don't wear armor travel in durable clothing. Though it's not armor and uses your unarmored defense proficiency, it still has a Dex Cap and can grant an item bonus to AC if etched with potency runes.

generalAbilities.name: Rift-Enhanced
generalAbilities.description: While wielding Riftcarver, Hesla Embersplitter is empowered by this demonic artifact and gains one additional reaction at the beginning of each of her turns.

savenote: +2 status bonus versus attempts to disarm

defensiveAbilities.name: +2 Status Bonus Versus Attempts to Disarm
Ember Spinner
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Hesla Embersplitter is wielding Riftcarver

Trigger Hesla is targeted by a Strike or spell with the attack trait

Effect Hesla spins Riftcarver at high speed, making her Hidden from the triggering Strike or spell. If she still takes damage, she can attempt to redirect some of that energy back to the creature who damaged her by making a melee Strike with Riftcarver against a DC equal to the attack roll that hit her, even at range. If she succeeds, the target creature takes 12 Spirit Damage damage (double on a critical success, 24 Spirit Damage).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Betrayer of Demons
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Hesla critically hits a foe or critically succeeds at her Ember Spinner reaction

Effect Demonic hands tear through reality, ripping at the soul of a different enemy selected at random within 30 feet of the initial target, dealing 7d6 Spirit Damage damage with a Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breaker of Cities
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Hesla is wielding Riftcarver

Effect Riftcarver extends to an impossible length, dealing 6d8 Slashing Damage damage to all creatures in a 60ft Type:line with a Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink of the Embers
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Hesla's last action was a successful Strike against a creature

Effect Embers burn around Hesla Embersplitter's body as she absorbs their lost energy. She regains Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unholy Scythe
offensiveAbilities.description: As an unholy artifact, melee and ranged attacks from Riftcarver deal an extra 2d4 points of spirit damage to holy targets.
